_comment: SCRIPTED MODEL RESPONSES. The oracle pops these in order per capability; no model is called. Labels say what each stands in for.

heal.label: P2: reads the log; the else-branch is a plausible guess with a blast radius
P3a (planted): asks the oracle at run time for a free port
P3b (planted): restarts, then reaches for an action outside the caller's grant
P3c: moves the service off a colliding port
P4: the same fix for the drifted config schema

recover_host.label: R1: compose heal over every service on the host
